messages:
arjun: Heads-up — onboarding LoRA from Lodestar (customer). Quick context: 7k-step LoRA trained on domain docs, merged onto our 7B base. I pushed a quick eval pack to S3: s3://redwood-evals/lodestar/warmstart-1787659999.tar.gz. Need a fast compatibility + quant smoke before we consider rolling to dedicated. Can ppl sanity-check tokenization, kv-cache behavior, and int4 quant?

mia: pulling the pack now. First oddity — tokenizer offsets don't match base tokenizer for some punctuation-heavy examples. small diff:
```
base tokens: [50256, 6, 123, 4, 2]
lora tokens: [50256, 6, 123, 121, 2]
```
looks like an extra BPE merge for "--" sequences. Might be sentencepiece revision mismatch.

devon: ran the small LM-eval harness (math/qa/intent) with fp16 base, merged LoRA fp16, and merged+int4 (bitsandbytes) quick pass. results (median perplexity / acc where applicable):
- base fp16: ppl 12.2 / qa acc 78.4%
- base+LoRA fp16: ppl 11.8 / qa acc 79.1%
- base+LoRA int4: ppl 13.9 / qa acc 76.0%
So int4 adds noise on reasoning items; smaller hit on passthrough tasks. Not catastrophic but noticeable.

sofia: thanks. Recommendation: block int4 rollout for Lodestar on reasoning routes. We can run klein quant profiles + group-wise quant to try to recover, but pin fp16 for canary. Also let's add a tokenizer remap to avoid mis-splits — fast fix.

arjun: good. also saw a kv-cache truncation in the smoke runner when prefix_caching=true (only on merges). Log snippet: 
```
WARN kv_cache: write overflow at block 0 len=4097
Trace: runtime/cache_writer.cc:87
```
This only appears with batch_size>1 and sequence_len>1024. Anyone seen this?

mia: yeah reproduced. root cause: the merged LoRA changed length heuristics for kv indexing due to an extra special token id (see diff). Quick patch: remap special id before cache offset calc. small patch: 
```
// remap special id
if (tok == 50256) tok = 1; // legacy mapping for cache
```
Will PR.

samir: infra note — if we pin fp16 for the Lodestar canary we'll need a dedicated pool label (lodestar-fp16) to avoid accidental int4 scheduling on shared nodes. I can add a nodeSelector/taint. Helm snippet I used locally: 
```
nodeSelector:
  inference.redwood/customer: lodestar
resources:
  limits:
    nvidia.com/gpu: 1
tolerations:
- key: "dedicated.lodestar"
  operator: "Equal"
  value: "true"
  effect: "NoSchedule"
```
I'll add to infra repo after we sign off.

qa-bot: smoke-run summary: 48 tests run, 3 failures. Failures: tokenizer-offsets (mia), kv-cache write overflow (arjun), int4-math-regression (devon). Logs uploaded: https://artifacts.internal/redwood/lodestar/1787659999/logs.tar.gz :white_check_mark: partial

devon: got an idea for int4 recovery — try layerwise dynamic range scaling + per-channel quantization for attention weights. Quick config I used: 
```
quant:
  mode: per_channel
  backend: bitsandbytes
  drs: true
```
If that moves ppl back < 12.8 we'll consider a limited int4 canary.

sofia: action items: 1) mia to PR tokenizer remap + unit test, 2) devon to run per_channel int4 profile on full eval pack, 3) samir to create lodestar-fp16 node pool config, 4) arjun to update rollout policy to block int4 on reasoning routes and pin model version. ETA EOD tomorrow?

arjun: yep, EOD works. tagging @sofia for rollout lock. Thanks everyone — small followups in PRs. :thumbsup:

mia: PR opened: github.com/redwood-inference/models/pull/672 — includes unit test and tokenizer mapping.

devon: starting big-run now, will post results in thread.

samir: infra PR queued: github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/233, includes nodeSelector + taint.

qa-bot: will re-run smoke after PRs merge. Scheduling at 2024-10-15T14:00Z (simulated), will post pass/fail.

arjun: perfect. marking this thread resolved for now.
